title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Comprehensive privacy policy template for businesses collecting biometric data. Covers facial recognition, consent, data protection & compliance.
description: A complete privacy policy template for organizations that collect, process, or store biometric data including facial recognition. Ensures compliance with biometric privacy laws while protecting user rights and establishing clear consent procedures.

sections.heading: Biometric Data Collection Notice
sections.content: This policy governs our collection and use of biometric information, including facial recognition data, fingerprints, voiceprints, and other unique biological identifiers. We collect biometric data for the following purposes: [PURPOSE]. Before collecting any biometric information, we will provide you with written notice and obtain your written consent. You have the right to refuse consent without penalty.

placeholders.label: Purpose of biometric data collection
placeholders.defaultValue: security access control and identity verification

sections.heading: Types of Biometric Information Collected
sections.content: We may collect the following types of biometric identifiers: facial geometry and facial recognition templates, fingerprint scans and templates, voice recognition patterns, iris or retinal scans, hand geometry measurements. We do not collect biometric information from minors under 14 years of age without parental consent.

sections.heading: Consent and Opt-Out Rights
sections.content: Your consent is required before we collect, capture, or otherwise obtain your biometric identifiers. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at [CONTACT_INFO]. Withdrawal of consent will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before withdrawal. You will not be denied services solely for refusing to provide biometric information unless it is essential for the specific service requested.

sections.heading: Data Security and Storage
sections.content: Biometric information is stored using industry-standard encryption and security measures. We implement physical, technical, and administrative safeguards including encrypted databases, access controls, and regular security audits. Biometric data is stored separately from personal identifying information when technically feasible. We retain biometric information for no longer than [RETENTION_PERIOD] or until you withdraw consent, whichever occurs first.

placeholders.label: Data retention period
placeholders.defaultValue: 3 years after your last interaction with our services

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content: We do not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from your biometric information. We may share biometric data only in the following limited circumstances: with your explicit written consent, when required by law or legal process, with service providers who assist in data processing under strict confidentiality agreements, in emergency situations to protect life or safety. Third parties who receive biometric information are bound by the same privacy protections outlined in this policy.

sections.heading: Your Rights and Data Subject Requests
sections.content: You have the right to: access information about what biometric data we have collected, request correction of inaccurate biometric information, request deletion of your biometric data, receive a copy of your biometric information in a portable format, lodge complaints with relevant supervisory authorities. To exercise these rights, contact us at [PRIVACY_CONTACT]. We will respond to your request within [RESPONSE_TIME] days.

sections.heading: Legal Compliance and Regulatory Framework
sections.content: This policy complies with applicable biometric privacy laws including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act, and other state and federal regulations. We regularly review and update our practices to maintain compliance with evolving privacy laws. For users in the European Union, this policy also complies with GDPR requirements for processing biometric data as special category personal data.

sections.heading: Policy Updates and Contact Information
sections.content: We may update this biometric privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by [NOTIFICATION_METHOD]. The effective date of this policy is [EFFECTIVE_DATE]. For questions about this policy or our biometric data practices, contact our Data Protection Officer at [DPO_CONTACT]. You may also contact us by mail at [MAILING_ADDRESS].

placeholders.label: Method for policy update notifications
placeholders.defaultValue: email and prominent notice on our website
